feeds.title: Dentiq Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Sundar Jagadeesan opened Dentiq Dental in Greenmeadows, Napier in 2019. He has been practicing dentistry since 2002 and is a fully qualified Napier dentist, and has completed advanced dental qualifications in Seattle. Dentiq boasts a highly qualified and experienced team who are passionate about improving the quality, vitality, and general well-being of their customers through effective dental care and treatments.

feeds.title: Fraser Dental Blog
feeds.description: Fraser Dental is a full-service, affordable dental clinic conveniently located in the heart of Hobsonville. Together with our sister practice McIntosh Dental in Lincoln Road, Henderson, we are at the forefront of New Zealand's dental profession, continually upskilling to ensure our dental services are the best quality possible.

feeds.title: Newmarket Family Dental Care Blog
feeds.description: With over 25 years of experience, you can be sure the treatment you receive from our Newmarket dentist will be completed with the utmost precision and care. We offer top-quality dentistry that is affordable, friendly, and convenient.

feeds.title: McIntosh Dental Centre Blog
feeds.description: McIntosh dental is able to tackle practically any dental case your loved ones may have, all in-house! And even offer anxiety management solutions to alleviate all your worries. Our highly experienced clinicians with advanced qualifications and a wealth of experience have been helping West Aucklanders to smile for over 35 years. Our sedation and anxiety management solutions can help you get rid of your fear of dentistry.

feeds.title: Fresh Dental Blog
feeds.description: As an established dental practice for over 25 years, our new owners have recently invested in completely modern, state-of-the-art resources, bridging technology with experience. Our main goal is to provide you with quality care, reassurance, and respect. Our team takes a judgment-free approach to care, helping you regain your oral health in the most comfortable manner possible.

feeds.title: Team Dental
feeds.description: We provide quality general dental services! We are not focused on the latest 'bells and whistles but have strength in our size; sharing policies, processes, buying power, knowledge, and expertise between our teams. Seek advice and information about regular dental issues and updates on new technology and practices in dentistry. Visit the Team Dental Blog.

feeds.title: Opal Dental Blog
feeds.description: At Opal Dental, we want to help you protect your oral health. That's why our talented team of dentists has created their very own blog. In addition to the latest news about our practice, you'll benefit from free advice on taking care of your oral health. From everyday guides to specialist areas such as wisdom teeth, we cover it all.

feeds.title: Blockhouse Bay Dental Centre Blog
feeds.description: We're proud to carry on a tradition of serving our Blockhouse Bay community with high-quality dental care in a modern, comfortable and spacious environment. Our mission is to provide excellence in dental care to enable you to enjoy the life enhancement that can be gained from excellent oral health.

feeds.title: Tam Dental Group Blog
feeds.description: Dr Tam is a passionate and approachable individual, Auckland cosmetic dentist Clarence Tam, HBSc, DDS, AAACD, FIADFE is committed to having an interactive approach with patients in all of her cases to maximize predictability. Check out our Auckland practice's dental blog to discover the latest news, technology, and treatment options that can help you meet your goals.

feeds.title: Primecare Dental Blog
feeds.description: We aim to provide the highest quality of dentistry available, personalized to your smile so that you can have teeth you can trust and a smile you love. We want you to be confident in your smile so that you can share your smile with your community. Our commitment to continual investments in our practice environment, equipment, and dentists is a promise so that we provide the quality of care our clients deserve.

feeds.title: City Dentists Blog
feeds.description: Our dentists and dental hygienists have a wide area of expertise and are highly trained in dental implants, teeth whitening, dental veneers, dental crowns, sedation dentistry, wisdom teeth, hygiene treatment, and many other dental treatments. We look forward to welcoming you to our centrally located dental practice and discussing with you the many updated options available for your dental care.

feeds.title: Duxton Dental Blog
feeds.description: Located just off the Hagley Park end of Riccarton Road, Riccarton, Christchurch; Duxton Dental aims to provide the highest standards of dental health, function, and aesthetics, to ensure your well-being and to promote good health. We offer first-class and innovative dental care with a smile. Browse Duxton Dental's blog page for guides, and tips and to stay updated on the latest news and innovations in the dental industry.

feeds.title: Central Hutt Dental Blog
feeds.description: Central Hutt Dental will be operating eleven dental chairs, with a dedicated orthodontic department for our growing orthodontic clientele that requires aligners and braces. Read our blogs regarding topics for your dental hygiene and what the latest dentistry treatments are so you're up to date. Our team's aim is to provide you with the best overall dental experience possible with our client experience, cutting-edge facility, highly skilled and experienced team, and modern techniques and technologies.

feeds.title: Thompson Dental Blog
feeds.description: Our friendly dental clinic located in Mt Albert Road, Mt Roskill welcomes all families and individual patients. You will find our dentists gentle and approachable, endeavouring to appease any anxiety you may feel about dentistry. Learn about dental health, cosmetic dentistry, gum disease, teeth grinding, skin rejuvenation, and community news.

feeds.title: Pathway Dental Blog
feeds.description: We know that you expect us to be knowledgeable and gentle, and we strive to be the very best in our field. Quality of care, quality of workmanship, quality of experience - these are the things that set us apart. We are committed to providing the highest standards at the most affordable price relieving you of any tension that many have in the dentist chair. Check out our dental blog for tips and advice for a healthy mouth and smile.

feeds.title: Hutt Dental Hub Blog
feeds.description: Our brand new dental rooms have just opened their doors to provide our community in the Hutt valley with the very best general, cosmetic, and emergency dental health care. We form part of the Hutt Valley Health Hub in central Lower Hutt, bringing together a range of health providers conveniently in one central place. Read our recent blogs from your local Lower Hutt Dentists.

feeds.title: Northmed Dental Blog
feeds.description: At Northmed Dental Centre, we strive for excellence and quality dental care. Our purpose-built facility is equipped to cover all aspects of general dentistry, cosmetics, minor oral surgery, and orthodontics. You will find a friendly team with the latest gadgets and cutting-edge knowledge and skills. Read more about our services and tips to help you maintain the best smile ever.

feeds.title: Dental Plus Blog
feeds.description: Our highly trained, experienced, and friendly staff will help you to find out what treatment options will be the most beneficial for you. At DentalPlus we offer a wide range of ethical and pain-free dental care. These include Invisalign, orthodontics, smile enhancement, and other specialized dental treatments all with interest-free finance options available. The goal of our blog is to provide a source of meaningful, common-sense dental information and health care advice.

feeds.title: Pure NZ Dental Blog
feeds.description: We provide quality dental care with compassion and gentleness using the latest dental technology because everyone deserves quality dentistry with integrity. We want to help you learn about your oral health and make decisions that are best for you. Read about the latest happenings in Oral healthcare, and learn more about our community right here on our blog.

feeds.title: DRCNZ News
feeds.description: DRC NZ is a 100% New Zealand-owned supplier to the Dental and Orthodontic Industry. Our mission is to help dentists to work more efficiently and achieve their treatment goals with products and services to maximize results. We are a small dedicated team and nothing is too much trouble for our customers and your patients. Above all our commitment to the Dental community is to supply an extensive range of high-quality innovative products at very reasonable prices.

feeds.title: Naenae Dental Clinic Blog
feeds.description: At Naenae Dental Clinic, we are committed to providing you with a stress-free visit with results that you will be proud to show off. We have a staff with more than 100 years of total dental practice expertise. We aim for dental perfection and stay current on the newest dental technologies. Check out our blogs by Naenae Dental about new dental technology and what is best for your oral health.

feeds.title: Confi Dental Advanced Dentistry Blog
feeds.description: Our vision is to spread confident smiles throughout Auckland. We offer quality dental treatments at affordable prices, and we do it as painlessly as possible. We also believe that your oral health is the mirror of your general health, so our range of dental services always considers your overall well-being.

feeds.title: Smart Dentist Blog
feeds.description: SmartDentist is passionate about patient care and dental education. We empower you to take your oral health care to the next level with innovative digital solutions. Our digital workflows are designed to create 'facially driven' smiles. We start with a smile design that suits your face and then we engineer the mechanics into it. Visit our blog section to learn about our services, how we work, our equipment, and more.

feeds.title: Gentle Dental Wellington Blog
feeds.description: As the gentlest dentists in Wellington, our goal is to provide a high standard of care in a relaxed and friendly environment with a gentle touch! Together, our technology, expertise, and gentle approach enable us to produce top-quality results in all aspects of dentistry.
